title: Carve 0.2 heading slug
description: The character tables of the slug that gives a heading its generated id (C2-H-143 to C2-H-148): the characters removed before the slug is computed, the glyphs written back to their ASCII source, and the transliteration of the four `ascii` values of `headingIds`. `removed` is sorted by `code_point`, `reversed` by `glyph`, `transliteration.folds` by `letter`.

code_point.description: The removed character, as `U+` and four to six upper-case hex digits, since most of these characters are invisible.

name.description: The Unicode name of the character, in lower case.

glyph.description: One character, typed or written by smart typography.

ascii.description: The ASCII characters that stand for the glyph in the slug.

transliteration.description: The transliteration of C2-H-147: each letter of `folds` is replaced by its ASCII spelling, then the text is decomposed canonically, the combining marks from `marks.first` to `marks.last` are removed, and the rest is composed canonically again.

letter.description: One letter that a canonical decomposition does not reduce to ASCII.

clauses.description: The clause ids of the six 0.2 documents that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.
